# Formnexa

> Free, watermark-free online workspace for professional invoices, ATS-ready resumes, and fast PDF conversion tools with zero sign-up required.

Formnexa is designed for freelancers, small businesses, contractors, and job seekers worldwide. All documents render in real-time, preserve crisp vector typography, support multi-currency billing (USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, SGD, AED, and more), and export directly to clean A4 PDFs.

## Core Applications

- [Free Invoice Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/invoice-generator): Create professional multi-currency invoices with tax lines, discounts, digital signatures, corporate logos, and instant PDF downloads.
- [Free ATS Resume Builder](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/resume-builder): Build ATS-friendly resumes across 10 layout engines and 15+ modern templates, or import existing PDF/DOCX resumes with intelligent section parsing.
- [Resume Templates Gallery](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/resume-templates): Browse 15+ recruiter-approved resume and CV templates across Modern, Minimal, Tech, and Executive styles.
- [Invoice Templates Gallery](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/templates): Browse 20+ invoice design templates tailored for freelancers, agencies, contractors, and consulting firms.
- [Free Online PDF Converter Hub](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert): 10 dedicated PDF conversion tools for converting documents and images without watermarks.

## Document Generators

- [Receipt Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/receipt-generator): Generate clean payment receipts with payment methods and balance settled.
- [Quote Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/quote-generator): Build formal price quotations with validity terms and itemized pricing.
- [Estimate Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/estimate-generator): Create job estimates covering labor, materials, and contingency terms.
- [Credit Note Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/credit-note-generator): Issue credit notes and refund memos referencing original invoice numbers.
- [Purchase Order Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/purchase-order-generator): Issue formal purchase orders with shipping terms and vendor info.
- [Sales Order Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/sales-order-generator): Confirm customer purchases before fulfillment.
- [Proforma Invoice Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/proforma-invoice-generator): Issue preliminary commercial invoices for international shipping and customs.
- [Timesheet Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/timesheet-generator): Track weekly contractor and employee hours with billable rates and sign-off blocks.
- [Work Order Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/work-order-generator): Create service job orders with maintenance instructions and parts lists.
- [Account Statement Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/account-statement-generator): Generate chronological customer billing ledgers and balance statements.
- [Packing Slip Generator](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/packing-slip-generator): Print shipment packing slips and manifest checklists.

## PDF Conversion Tools

- [PDF to Word Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF files into editable DOCX documents preserving layout and fonts.
- [Word to PDF Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/word-to-pdf): Convert Microsoft Word (.docx, .doc) files into clean, vector-sharp PDFs.
- [JPG to PDF Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/jpg-to-pdf): Merge photos and scans (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single multi-page PDF.
- [PDF to JPG Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/pdf-to-jpg): Extract high-resolution image pages from PDF documents.
- [Excel to PDF Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/excel-to-pdf): Turn XLSX/CSV spreadsheets into formatted A4 landscape/portrait PDFs.
- [PDF to Excel Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/pdf-to-excel): Extract data tables from PDFs into clean Excel sheets.
- [PowerPoint to PDF Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/powerpoint-to-pdf): Convert presentation slide decks into presentation-ready PDFs.
- [PDF to PowerPoint Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/pdf-to-powerpoint): Turn PDF pages into editable presentation slides.
- [HTML to PDF Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/html-to-pdf): Render web code or live URLs to vector PDFs.
- [PDF to PDF/A Converter](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/convert/pdf-to-pdfa): Convert PDFs into ISO-compliant archival PDF/A documents.

## Guides & Documentation

- [Guides Blog](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/blog): In-depth guides on billing compliance, ATS resume formatting, and file workflows.
- [International Invoice Format Guide](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/blog/international-invoice-format-asia-usa-europe-guide): Cross-border billing standards across Asia, the USA, and Europe covering VAT, GST, and EIN.
- [How to Write an ATS-Friendly Resume](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/blog/how-to-write-ats-friendly-resume-guide): Recruiter guidelines for passing ATS screening filters.
- [Invoice vs Receipt vs Quote vs Proforma](https://formnexa.dcpakpattan.gov.pk/blog/invoice-vs-receipt-vs-quote-vs-proforma): Overview of business document types and when to issue each.
